q: How much energy do Bikaner plaster of Paris units use, and how much is petcoke?
title: Bikaner plaster of Paris: petcoke and power
short: TERI's Bikaner profile puts the cluster at 20,050 toe a year: petcoke 18,830 toe, about 96%, and 14.2 million kWh of grid power. About 75 of the 150 units run, making some 470,000 t of plaster. That comes to roughly 86,000 t CO2 a year (estimate).
audience: Plaster of Paris makers in Khara and the other RIICO estates around Bikaner

p: Rajasthan mines nearly all of India's gypsum, 98.8% of 2.93 million t in 2013-14, and Bikaner has beds up to 30 m thick. Most working units sit in RIICO's Khara estate, about 15 km from the city, many doing job work under other brands. More than 95% of the plaster leaves the state, and 10 to 15% is exported, mainly to Nepal.

Gypsum is loaded into a mild steel drum, 3 ft across and 6 ft long, holding 1 or 2 t, and turned at 5 to 10 rpm over a fluidised bed of pulverised petcoke. At 150 to 200 C it gives up three quarters of its water and becomes plaster; about 20 to 25% of the weight leaves as steam. The flue gas leaves at 700 C or more with nothing recovering it, and petcoke runs at 50 to 60 kg per tonne of gypsum.

ul: Heating gypsum releases water, not process CO2, so all the CO2 comes from fuel and power.
Petcoke: about 77,000 t CO2 a year across the cluster, close to 90% of the total.
Electricity for crushers, pulverisers and drum drives: about 9,600 t.
Energy is 24 to 26% of production cost, so the same changes cut the bill.
We work from toe because the cluster table's petcoke tonnage, 269,000 t, does not square with its own 18,830 toe.

sections.h: What TERI expects a better furnace to save
ul: Recover flue heat to preheat combustion air to 250 to 300 C: every 22 C off the flue saves about 1% of fuel, 10 to 15% in all.
Insulating brick and ceramic fibre in walls, floor and crown, which are now plain red brick.
Temperature probes at three points on the crown, so firing is not judged by eye.
A redesigned furnace with all of these: about 20%, some 4,000 toe a year for the cluster.

example.title: Bikaner cluster, CO2 a year (estimate)
lines: Electricity: 14.2 million kWh x 0.675 kg = 9,585 t CO2
Per tonne of plaster: 86,450 / 470,000 = about 184 kg CO2
example.note: Energy and output from TERI's Bikaner plaster of Paris profile (2016). Petcoke at the IPCC 2006 default for petroleum coke; grid factor CEA FY 2025-26.
